output.reason: The upgrade guide [ev-01e97dc9c4df] names two impacts: reports may be affected, and mutate/generate policies on custom resources may break. The render diffs show the reports controller also lost its */* get/list/watch permission [ev-fbb2a078179b][ev-8034700c2e78][ev-2e7e175db33a], as did the background controller [ev-0ae726bec846]. The proposed condition only matches environments with mutate or generate rules, so it misses environments whose reports (for example from validate-only policies) depend on resources the default view role does not cover. A corrected exposure has to cover both impacts within the depth limit. It therefore conditions on Kyverno policies being in use plus an undecidable leaf covering both impacts.

correction.statement: Kyverno 1.13 removes the controllers' wildcard view permission and binds them to the default view role instead. Any environment running Kyverno ClusterPolicies or Policies is potentially exposed: reports, or mutate/generate policies, may lose access to resources (such as custom resources) that the view role does not grant.

of.needed: whether policy reports or mutate/generate policies need Kyverno controllers to read resources (e.g. custom resources) that the cluster's default view role does not grant
